data.narrative:
Tritone Technologies is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company founded by Ofer Ben-Zur. Valuation analysis draws on a comparable set of 9 private and 1 public peer in the sector, with primary reliance on 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private peers: Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B Series B), Dexterity ($1.6B Series B), Hadrian ($1.6B Series C), and Nimble Robotics ($1.0B Series C).

The peer-median approach yields $1.6B, supported by the observed range of $1.0B to $1.8B across the comparables. This single triangulation method anchors the valuation, as it directly reflects recent pricing for robotics companies at Tritone's stage and sector. The median holds appropriately between the tightest clustering (Dexterity and Hadrian both at $1.6B) and the outliers (Bedrock at the high end, Nimble at the low end).

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.4B (low) to $1.9B (high), centered at $1.6B. Key uncertainties include Tritone's own capital raised to date (undisclosed), the specific technology differentiation relative to the peer set, and revenue or customer traction metrics relative to comparables. Reliance on a single methodological input limits conviction; additional methods (revenue multiples, DCF) would strengthen the range if supporting data were available.
